snippet.title: Arcade Longplay [1074] Ninja Kazan (JP)
snippet.description:
http://www.longplays.org

Played by: Ravenlord

From MobyGames:
'A ninja named Kazan possesses a secret letter and goes on a quest around the world to recover four others (together they make up the book of the five gods) to prevent the secret magic techniques from falling into the hands of demonic forces. Kazan fights his way through ancient temples infested with demons and riddled with traps.'
